note: Static explainers for Macro Engine pillars, keyed by engine row id. Content: Hercules (COLLAB.md spec, 2026-10-08). Update `live` as conditions change.

fiscal.body: Deficits, debt sustainability, sovereign spreads. Funds stress leaks into the currency.
fiscal.live: EU summit day 2: the Iran war has added €100B+ to Europe's fossil-fuel import bill — the euro's energy-fiscal double hit into winter. France's revenue vote Oct 20, Moody's Oct 23; the Socialist motion failed 236–149.
fiscal.title: Fiscal & sovereign risk

growth.body: Who is accelerating, who is stalling (GDP, jobs, PMIs). Always comparative. Stronger growth pulls in capital and raises hike expectations.
growth.live: Split: UK GDP beat (+0.1%, 3m/3m +0.7%); Australia jobs -39.3K, unemp 4.7% (5-yr high); Japan machinery +5.2% beat vs IP -2.4% miss. PPI/retail/claims Thu 7:30am CT is the US verdict.
growth.title: Growth differentials

inflation.body: CPI/PCE vs the central bank's target. High inflation alone strengthens nothing — what matters is what the bank does about it.
inflation.live: PPI Thu 7:30am CT (fcst 0.6% m/m, core 0.3%) decides whether the CPI broadening continues — core beat twice (0.3%/2.6%). German WPI +8.7%. Beige Book: oil 'permeated all District reports.' October just got pushed back toward a hold.
inflation.title: Inflation

policy.body: Central banks moving in different directions. It is the gap between them that moves currencies: money flows toward higher rates.
policy.live: October talked back down: Bowman ('no urgency') + Daly knocked Oct 27–28 from ~49% to ~31.6%; Dec ~90–94% (Citi flipped: 25bp). 10Y to 3-wk low 5.1267%. ECB Oct ~12%/Dec live (Simkus); BoJ Oct ~9%/Dec >80%; BoE Nov ~86%+; RBA Nov questioned after jobs miss; BoC ~25%; RBNZ two-way.
policy.title: Policy divergence

positioning.body: Where speculators already stand (CFTC COT, Fridays). Crowded trades are fragile: if everyone is long dollars, nobody is left to buy. The contrarian lens — where would a surprise hurt most.
positioning.live: Verified COT (Oct 6 cut): DXY net +12,011 (modest); EUR shorts -99,332 (~1st pctile), AUD -98,588 (~2nd), GBP -97,611 — the squeeze risk sits in shorts, not dollar longs. Rule: stretched shorts = squeeze potential.
positioning.title: Positioning

risk.body: Risk-on vs risk-off. Fear bids USD, JPY, CHF (havens) and sells AUD, NZD, GBP (risk proxies).
risk.live: Risk-off: Nasdaq -1.9% (3rd day), Kospi -7.7%, Nikkei -4.8%, VIX 2-wk high, silver -6.1% — and no haven bid in FX. Fear through crude, not currencies.
risk.title: Risk sentiment

tot.body: Export prices vs import prices: oil, metals. The same price moves two currencies opposite ways — say which and why.
tot.live: Brent ~$104.5 (-1.3%), WTI ~$94.1 (-1.0%), spread ~$10.5 — shadow-fleet easing talk leaked the premium; API -11.1M draw ignored. EIA 11am CT. Gold ~$4,140 (+0.8%) as the rate leg eased.
tot.title: Terms of trade
